title: 第8章
content_zh:
周瑾宇觉得夏真钰这几句才真正表现出了她确实在机关单位工作有段时间了，很得体，也很真诚，但又不显得过于献媚。
将手机号码报给了周瑾宇，坐在前排的秘书记了下来，夏真钰认为他也就是做做样子，哪能真会给自己打电话呢。
这时车已经到了饭店的门口，夏真钰看见张处长、郭主任还有其他三辆车的人也都到了，正在门口等着呢。车停了下来，秘书动作迅速的下了车，
郭怀不大的眼睛有些诧异的看着夏真钰从周瑾宇的车上下来，他刚才已经忘记夏真钰这个人了，不过马上眼睛又眯成一条缝了，这个小夏还真是入了周大市长的眼啊，福将啊，福将！
众人簇拥着周瑾宇进了包房，安排座位时大家很默契的把主位和主位一侧的位置空了出来，所以当夏真钰跟在后面进来的时候，大家已经就绪了，只剩那两个位置没人坐了，她站在桌边不知道该怎么办。
小夏，愣着做什么啊，去坐好呀！郭怀看夏真钰还发呆呢，就赶紧让她去坐在周瑾宇的身边。
夏真钰没办法硬着头皮坐了下来，菜是秘书早已经点好的了，等大家都坐好了就开始陆续的走菜，很快满满一桌子饭菜就齐了。
今天这顿午餐是周市长个人请大家的，可不是公款吃喝哟！张处长率先开起了玩笑，大家也跟着哈哈笑，接着张处长又请周瑾宇讲话。
周瑾宇笑着端起了自己面前的纯净水说道：因为下午还要上班就不请大家喝酒了，不过饭菜还是管饱的，大家不要因为我在就感到拘谨，都多吃些，我以水代酒先敬大家。说完带头抿了一口杯中的水。
众人也都意思一下的喝了口水，然后就是一片感激称赞之声，周瑾宇依旧是温和的微笑，拿起筷子夹了一口菜放在碟子里，大家看他动筷了，才跟着吃了起来。
夏真钰知道这种场合是根本吃不好也吃不饱的，这么大的领导在这，自己还坐在他身边，只能吃吃面前的菜，还不能显得没见过世面似的多吃，真是受罪。
服务员不时进来照看，又特意给夏真钰上了一大杯果汁，又为她倒在小杯子里，大家都看了过来，张处长笑了笑说道：全桌就这么一个女同志，怎么也得给点特别的待遇啊，你们这些老爷们儿不会也爱喝这个吧？说得其他人都哄笑了起来，谁爱喝那么甜的东西呢。
周瑾宇看出夏真钰的不自在，起初想给她夹点菜，可是那就太显眼了，对她自身影响也不好，知道她拘谨吃不好也没什么办法。
除了夏真钰，大家吃得都很尽兴，周瑾宇很能调节气氛，本来有些冷清的场面他三言两语就让所有人都放松了，可就像张处长说的就她一个女的，而且是个连正式职务都没有的小小办事员，又能和谁交流呢。
出了饭店的门口，夏真钰想这回该和郭主任一辆车了吧，结果张处长又拉着郭主任一起上了车，自己只能又坐了周瑾宇的车，不过还好这回上了车周瑾宇只是闭目养神没说话，让她安心不少。
下午周瑾宇听了一会儿会议讨论，便有秘书来请他去主持另一场会议，周瑾宇离开之前肯定了郭怀这段时间的工作，说他确实提高了认识，改进力度很大。把郭怀兴奋得差点脑溢血，周市长居然记得他的名字了，还当着这么多人表扬了自己，回去一定还要再加强工作力度！
和郭主任回了单位，进了大厅，郭主任停了下来，满脸笑意的对夏真钰说道：小夏，今天表现非常不错，以前没发现你这么有工作潜力呢，真是损失啊。接着又把信息中心的李科长叫来，再次把夏真钰夸了一通，还要李科长一定在工作上好好照顾夏真钰，有什么困难都要尽快帮着解决，然后才得意的上楼了。
李科长有些不解的看着夏真钰，虽然他刚才满口答应，但他还真不知道工作如何照顾夏真钰，也不明白以前不显山不露水的夏真钰怎么突然就让郭主任这么重视了呢。
夏真钰无奈的看着李科长说：科长，不用什么照顾的，我会尽力工作不会给大家添太多麻烦的。那个，郭主任刚才在市里被周市长表扬了，主任非常高兴。
哦！原来是这么回事，李科长明白了难怪主任那么高兴，夏真钰无非是跟着借光罢了，也就不在意了，让夏真钰回去工作。

夏真钰糊弄过了李科长也放了心，不然让这些人知道了郭主任那莫名其妙的心思闲话就更多了。
过了几天清闲日子，期间周瑾宇的秘书打过几个电话询问相关具体数据，夏真钰认为自己以后可能就得充当数字信息中心和市政府办公厅的联络员了，因此更加认真的统计和审核相关内容。
这天因为自己有些感冒就请了假休息一天，快中午的时候朱主任打来了电话：小夏，感觉好点没？唉，要是没有紧急事情我也不会打扰你了。
夏真钰也有些着急，这么急找她应该是信息中心出了什么问题吧，于是说道：朱主任，您别这么说，出了什么事？需要我做什么我一定全力以赴。
别紧张，没出事儿。就是郭主任下午要去市里开会，事情有点紧急，这回是省里派人来调研，你得和郭主任一起去，小夏啊坚持坚持行吗？
行啊，几点？我马上去。夏真钰丝毫不犹豫。
嗯，我看看哪，现在已经快１２点了，会议是一点半，你和郭主任１点就得到，这样吧小夏，你呆会可别坐公交车了，打车快，回来给你报销。
就是不报销自己也得打车啊，不能耽误正事，夏真钰挂了电话立即开始收拾，出门时已经过了十五分钟了，便有点着急。
这时电话又响了，她以为是朱主任又有什么交待，直接按了通话键便说：主任，我已经出门了，还有什么事情吗？
对方带笑的声音传了过来：是我，你出门了？到哪了，我去接你。
这是谁啊，夏真钰莫名其妙想了一下说：对不起啊，你打错电话了吧。
没听出来吗？我是周瑾宇。
夏真钰差点摔下楼梯，站稳停在原地小心翼翼的说：周市长，我是夏真钰，您知道吗？
我当然知道自己给谁打电话呢，我正好在你家附近，开会的事情你知道了吧，时间有点紧，你在哪呢，我去接你正好一起走。
夏真钰这才确认，周瑾宇是真的准备接她一起去开会，想着周大市长怎么会知道自己住在哪儿的呢？
约在了小区大门口，没一会儿周瑾宇的车就过来了，秘书下车帮她开了车门，她还真有些不习惯这种高级服务，不过也没办法，高层领导就是这个规矩，自己也不好太小家子气。
周瑾宇看着坐进来的夏真钰，心情好了起来，刚才从车窗看她站在阳光下，脸更加白皙透明了，他自己知道对这个女孩，不，应该是女人是有些好感的，夏真钰说不上是特别漂亮，多得是比她美、比她柔的女人对自己投怀送抱，但他就是觉得怎么看夏真钰怎么顺眼，就是她什么也不做，静静的呆在那儿也能让他心情舒爽起来。
这些天让秘书不时与她沟通就是为了不让自己的出现太过于突然，也能让她放松心理，他自己没想过要和夏真钰进行到哪一步，只是先这么放着，想着她时能看看她就好。
怎么今天没上班？是不是有什么事？
正有点忐忑的夏真钰连忙说道：没什么事，就是有点感冒，头有些晕就请了假。从没想过这么大的领导查自己的勤，早知道就不请假了，反正病得也不严重。

发烧吗？吃了药没有？周瑾宇问得很仔细。
他是不是怕被自己传染啊，夏真钰开始乱想：不发烧，也没吃药，估计睡一觉就能好的。
周瑾宇没在问她什么，只让秘书在路过药店时买了些冲剂给她拿着，夏真钰再次钦佩周瑾宇的亲民路线，自己都快对他感恩戴德了，现在她完全能体会那天郭主任脑溢血的感觉。
周市长怎么会知道我住在哪儿的？夏真钰还是很好奇这个事情。
哦，刚才给你们主任打电话时，他顺口说的，我正好在这附近就顺便带你一程。周瑾宇回答得轻描淡写。
夏真钰听了也没一点儿怀疑，两人在车上聊着天，夏真钰现在倒不紧张了，可能是见面次数多了，而且周瑾宇一点也没领导架子，挺让人安心的。
到了市政府大楼门口，已经又是一群人在等候了，再次看见夏真钰从周瑾宇车上下来，郭怀不得不认真审视自己手下这个福将了，一回还好说是巧合，刚才接到会议通知的时候老朱可是说小夏感冒请了病假在家休息的，自己让老朱打电话给小夏看能不能坚持一下，这怎么就又和周市长一辆车过来了？
在官场沉浸了几十年，郭怀已经是人精了，立刻判断出周瑾宇对夏真钰可不仅仅是看着顺眼的问题了，如果周瑾宇真有那心思，他自然是愿意成其好事的，这对自己是只有利没有弊的事情。可关键是周市长知不知道小夏的已婚身份呢，这个还得探好风才行，不然弄不好自己就得砸里头。
其实这个会夏真钰还真没来的必要，就是郭主任也是坐着当摆设，说是省里调研，可是夏真钰看着那几个省里干部倒是巴着周瑾宇多些，全程一个劲儿点头说是说好，再夸上周瑾宇几句，只见周瑾宇谈笑风声，引经据典汇报工作，还真是引人入胜，大多数人都听呆了。
会议结束，晚上的招待饭局是跑不了的，夏真钰真心认为自己根本太多余，什么也不是总混上领导饭桌算怎么回事啊，就想和郭主任说下自己想打车回家。
content_en:
Zhou Jinyu felt that Xia Zhenyu's words really showed that she had indeed been working in an agency for some time. They were very decent and sincere, but not too flattering.
He reported his mobile phone number to Zhou Jinyu, and the secretary sitting in the front row wrote it down. Xia Zhenyu thought that he was just pretending, how could he really call him.
At this time, the car had arrived at the entrance of the hotel. Xia Zhenyu saw that Director Zhang, Director Guo and the people in the other three cars had also arrived and were waiting at the door. The car stopped and the secretary quickly got out of the car.
Guo Huai's small eyes looked at Xia Zhenyu getting off Zhou Jinyu's car with some surprise. He had forgotten about Xia Zhenyu just now, but his eyes narrowed again immediately. This Xiao Xia really caught the eye of Mayor Zhou, a lucky general, a lucky general!
Everyone surrounded Zhou Jinyu and entered the private room. When arranging the seats, everyone tacitly agreed to leave the main seat and the seat next to the main seat vacant. So when Xia Zhenyu followed in, everyone was already ready. Only those two seats were unoccupied. She stood at the table and didn't know what to do.
Xiaoxia, what are you doing standing still? Go and sit down! Seeing that Xia Zhenyu was still in a daze, Guo Huai quickly asked her to sit next to Zhou Jinyu.
Xia Zhenyu couldn't help but sit down. The secretary had already ordered the food. When everyone was seated, the food started to be taken out one after another. Soon a table full of food was ready.
Today’s lunch is a personal treat for everyone, Mayor Zhou, and it is not a meal or drink with public funds! Director Zhang took the lead in making a joke, and everyone laughed along with him. Then Director Zhang invited Zhou Jinyu to speak.
Zhou Jinyu smiled and picked up the pure water in front of him and said: I won't invite you to drink because I have to go to work in the afternoon, but the food is still enough. Don't feel restrained just because I'm here. Eat more. I'll serve you water instead of wine. After speaking, he took the lead and took a sip of the water in the glass.
Everyone also took a sip of water, and then there was a sound of gratitude and praise. Zhou Jinyu still smiled gently, picked up the chopsticks, took a bite of food and put it on the plate. Everyone watched him move the chopsticks before they started eating.
Xia Zhenyu knew that it was impossible to eat well or be full on such an occasion. Such a big leader was here, and she was still sitting next to him. She could only eat the food in front of her, but she couldn't eat as much as if she had never seen the world. It was really painful.
The waiter came in from time to time to take care of her, and specially gave Xia Zhenyu a large glass of juice, and poured it into a small cup for her. Everyone looked over, and Director Zhang smiled and said: There is only such a lesbian in the whole table, so why should we give her some special treatment? Don't you gentlemen also like to drink this? The others laughed because who likes to drink something so sweet?
Zhou Jinyu noticed Xia Zhenyu's discomfort and wanted to get her some food at first, but it was too conspicuous and would have a bad impact on her. Knowing that she was cautious and couldn't eat well, there was nothing he could do.
Except for Xia Zhenyu, everyone had a great time eating. Zhou Jinyu was very good at adjusting the atmosphere. He made everyone relax in the originally deserted scene with a few words, but as Director Zhang said, she was the only woman, and she was a small clerk without even a formal position. Who could she communicate with.
After leaving the door of the hotel, Xia Zhenyu thought it was time to get in a car with Director Guo this time, but Director Zhang pulled Director Guo into the car again. She could only sit in Zhou Jinyu's car again, but fortunately, Zhou Jinyu just closed his eyes and calmed down without speaking when he got in the car this time, which made her feel more at ease.
In the afternoon, Zhou Jinyu listened to the meeting discussion for a while, and then a secretary came and asked him to chair another meeting. Before leaving, Zhou Jinyu affirmed Guo Huai's work during this period, saying that he had indeed improved his understanding and made great improvements. Guo Huai was so excited that he almost had a cerebral hemorrhage. Mayor Zhou actually remembered his name and praised himself in front of so many people. He must work harder when he returns!After returning to the unit with Director Guo and entering the lobby, Director Guo stopped and said to Xia Zhenyu with a smile on his face: "Xiaoxia, you performed very well today. I didn't realize that you have such working potential before. What a loss." Then he called Section Chief Li from the information center and praised Xia Zhenyu again. He also asked Section Chief Li to take good care of Xia Zhenyu at work and help solve any difficulties as soon as possible. Then he went upstairs proudly.
Section Chief Li looked at Xia Zhenyu with some confusion. Although he had promised Xia Zhenyu just now, he really didn't know how to take care of Xia Zhenyu at work, and he didn't understand why Xia Zhenyu, who used to be so humble, suddenly attracted so much attention from Director Guo.
Xia Zhenyu looked at Section Chief Li helplessly and said: Section Chief, you don't need to take care of me. I will try my best to not cause too much trouble to everyone. Well, Director Guo was praised by Mayor Zhou in the city just now. The director was very happy.
oh! It turned out that this was what happened. Section Chief Li understood that no wonder the director was so happy. Xia Zhenyu was just borrowing money, so he didn't care and let Xia Zhenyu go back to work.
Xia Zhenyu was relieved after fooling Section Chief Li, otherwise there would have been more gossip if these people knew about Director Guo's inexplicable thoughts.
After a few days of leisure, Zhou Jinyu's secretary made several calls to inquire about relevant specific data. Xia Zhenyu thought that he might have to serve as a liaison between the Digital Information Center and the Municipal Government Office in the future, so he counted and reviewed the relevant content more carefully.
I took a day off because I had a cold. At almost noon, Director Zhu called me: Xiaoxia, are you feeling better? Alas, I wouldn't bother you if there was nothing urgent.
Xia Zhenyu was also a little anxious. There must be something wrong with the information center to find her so urgently, so he said, "Director Zhu, don't say that. What happened?" I will do my best to do whatever is required of me.
Don't be nervous, nothing happened. Director Guo is going to the city for a meeting in the afternoon. The matter is a bit urgent. This time the province is sending people to investigate. You have to go with Director Guo. Xiaoxia, can you insist on it?
Okay, what time? I'll go right away. Xia Zhenyusi did not hesitate.
Well, let me see, it is almost 12 o'clock now, the meeting is at 1:30, you and Director Guo will get it at 1 o'clock, so Xiaoxia, don't take the bus if you stay for a while, take a taxi quickly, I will reimburse you when I come back.
Even if he doesn't reimburse himself, he still has to take a taxi. He can't delay the business. Xia Zhenyu hung up the phone and immediately started to pack up. It was already fifteen minutes before he left, so he was a little anxious.
At this time, the phone rang again. She thought it was Director Zhu who had something to explain, so she pressed the call button and said: Director, I have already gone out, is there anything else?
The other party's laughing voice came over: It's me, are you out? Wherever you are, I'll pick you up.
Who is this? Xia Zhenyu thought for a while and said: I'm sorry, you dialed the wrong number.
Didn't you hear it? My name is Zhou Jinyu.
Xia Zhenyu almost fell down the stairs, stood firm and said carefully: Mayor Zhou, I am Xia Zhenyu, do you know?
Of course I know who I'm calling. I happen to be near your house. You know about the meeting. Time is a bit tight. Where are you? I'll pick you up and we'll go together.
Only then did Xia Zhenyu confirm that Zhou Jinyu was really planning to pick her up to go to the meeting. How could Mayor Zhou know where she lived?
They made an appointment at the gate of the community, and Zhou Jinyu's car came over soon. The secretary got out of the car and opened the door for her. She was really not used to this kind of high-end service, but there was nothing she could do about it. This was the rule of senior leaders, and she couldn't be too petty.
Zhou Jinyu looked at Xia Zhenyu who had sat in, and his mood improved. He had just seen her standing in the sun from the car window, and her face was fairer and more transparent. He himself knew that there was something wrong with this girl, no, it should be a woman.Xia Zhenyu, whom he liked, could not be said to be particularly beautiful. There were many women who were prettier and softer than her and threw themselves into his arms, but he just felt that Xia Zhenyu was pleasing to his eyes. Even if she did nothing and stayed there quietly, it would make him feel better.
These days, the secretary communicates with her from time to time in order to prevent his appearance from being too sudden and to relax her mind. He himself has not thought about how far he will go with Xia Zhenyu, he just leaves it like this for now and can look at her when he thinks about her.
Why didn't you go to work today? Is something wrong?
Xia Zhenyu, who was a little worried, said quickly: "Nothing's wrong, I just have a cold and a little dizzy, so I asked for leave." I never thought that such a big leader would check my attendance. If I had known about it, I wouldn't have asked for leave. Anyway, the illness was not serious.
Have a fever? Have you taken any medicine? Zhou Jinyu asked carefully.
Is he afraid of being infected by himself? Xia Zhenyu began to think wildly: If he doesn't have a fever and doesn't take medicine, he will probably be fine after just sleeping.
Zhou Jinyu didn't ask her anything, and just asked the secretary to buy some granules for her when passing by the pharmacy. Xia Zhenyu once again admired Zhou Jinyu's people-friendly approach, and she was almost grateful to him. Now she could fully understand the feeling of Director Guo's cerebral hemorrhage that day.
How did Mayor Zhou know where I lived? Xia Zhenyu is still curious about this matter.
Oh, when I called your director just now, he said casually that I happened to be nearby and would give you a ride. Zhou Jinyu answered lightly.
Xia Zhenyu didn't have any doubts after hearing this. The two chatted in the car. Xia Zhenyu was not nervous now, maybe because they had met more often, and Zhou Jinyu didn't have any leadership arrogance at all, which was quite reassuring.
When he arrived at the door of the municipal government building, there was already a group of people waiting. When he saw Xia Zhenyu getting off Zhou Jinyu's car again, Guo Huai had to take a serious look at his lucky general. At first, he said it was a coincidence. When he received the meeting notice just now, Lao Zhu said that Xiao Xia had a cold and took sick leave to rest at home. He asked Lao Zhu to call Xiao Xia to see if he could hold on. Why did he come in the same car with Mayor Zhou again?
After being immersed in official circles for decades, Guo Huai was already a good person, and he immediately judged that Zhou Jinyu's attraction to Xia Zhenyu was more than just a matter of being pleasing to the eye. If Zhou Jinyu really had that intention, he would naturally be willing to do something good for him, which would only benefit him without any disadvantages. But the key is whether Mayor Zhou knows Xiao Xia's married status. This needs to be done carefully, otherwise he will have to get in trouble.
In fact, there was really no need for Xia Zhenyu to come to this meeting. Even Director Guo was sitting there as a decoration, saying that it was for provincial research. However, Xia Zhenyu looked at the provincial cadres and looked at Zhou Jinyu more. He nodded and said yes throughout the whole process, and praised Zhou Jinyu a few times. He only saw Zhou Jinyu chatting and laughing, and citing classics to report on his work. It was really fascinating, and most people were stunned.
After the meeting was over, there was no way to attend the dinner reception in the evening. Xia Zhenyu really thought that he was too redundant and had nothing to do but just showed up at the leadership table, so he wanted to tell Director Guo that he wanted to take a taxi home.
